name: Late delivery — frustrated customer
description: Customer's order is late and they're frustrated

conversation.speaker: customer
conversation.text: Hi, my order ORD-10001 hasn't arrived yet and it was supposed to be here days ago.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Let me look into that for you. Can I get your order number?

conversation.speaker: customer
conversation.text: It's ORD-10001. I need this urgently, I've been waiting for 8 days now!

name: Refund request — polite customer
description: Customer wants a refund for a product they don't like

conversation.speaker: customer
conversation.text: Hello, I'd like to return a product and get a refund please.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Of course! I'd be happy to help with that. Could you share the order number?

conversation.speaker: customer
conversation.text: It's ORD-10002. I received it but it's not what I expected.

name: Cancellation request — urgent
description: Customer wants to cancel an order immediately

conversation.speaker: customer
conversation.text: I need to cancel my order right now! Order ORD-10003. I placed it by mistake.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: I understand, I'll check if we can still cancel it.

conversation.speaker: customer
conversation.text: Please hurry, I don't want it to ship!

name: Escalation request — angry customer
description: Customer is very angry and wants to speak to a supervisor

conversation.speaker: customer
conversation.text: This is absolutely unacceptable. My order has been missing for 3 weeks!

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: I sincerely apologize for this experience. Let me look into this immediately.

conversation.speaker: customer
conversation.text: I want to speak to your manager right now. This is ridiculous.

conversation.speaker: customer
conversation.text: Hi, can you tell me what your refund policy is?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Of course! Happy to help with that.

conversation.speaker: customer
conversation.text: How many days do I have to return something?
